name: Edge AI Camera Module
intro: Image capture, ISP, AI inference, video encoding and connectivity in one modular camera. Operates independently or connects to Raspberry Pi and other single-board computers.
heroAlt: OVIS camera with people and vehicle detection, drone detection, low-light imaging, web management and tracking demonstrations
stackAlt: OVIS modular stack with sensor, extension and core boards

modular.title: Open-source HDK and modular expansion
modular.intro: The OVIS hardware development kit (HDK) is open source. Users can use the published hardware design resources to develop expansion boards for their applications and stack them with the sensor and core boards through board-to-board connectors.

demos.title: Detection and tracking, on the camera.
demos.intro: Explore OVIS edge vision through recorded people, vehicle and drone detection and tracking demonstrations. Select a video to play.

manager.title: Configure devices. Deploy models.
manager.intro: Discover cameras, adjust video parameters and deploy models through a browser-based management interface.

specs.title: OVIS Technical Specifications
specs.intro: Key specifications for OVIS processors, memory, storage, imaging, interfaces and mechanical dimensions.

interfaces.title: Every board, clearly mapped.
interfaces.intro: Inspect components and connectors on the core, sensor and CVBS output boards. Select an image to enlarge it.

kits.title: Two ways to configure OVIS.
kits.intro: Start with the sensor and core boards, or add the MS7024 output board for CVBS analog video.

resources.title: Start building with OVIS.
resources.intro: Find documentation, access the web manager or discuss hardware integration and custom expansion with our engineers.

sensor.title: Sensor board
sensor.text: SC235HAI image sensor with 1080p at 60 FPS capture, paired with a 3.9 mm F1.0 lens.

core.title: OVIS core board
core.text: CV1842H-P processors and a 1.5 TOPS INT8 AI accelerator in a 20 × 20 × 5.7 mm core board.

extension.title: User-designed expansion boards
extension.text: Users can develop Wi-Fi, IMU or custom I/O expansion boards using the open-source HDK. The MS7024 CVBS output board is an existing expansion example.

people.title: People & vehicles
people.text: Detection with a P2 detection head.

street.title: Street tracking
street.text: Vehicle target tracking in a street scene.

fpv.title: FPV simulation tracking
fpv.text: Target tracking using simulated FPV footage.

performanceNote: Reference performance: 30 FPS for people/vehicle detection with a P2 head; 55 FPS for drone detection and tracking. Results vary by model, input size, quantization, firmware and configuration. Recording frame rate is not inference frame rate.
lowlightIntro: Explore low-light imaging with ISP and AI-BNR processing. The following videos are separate demonstrations.

discovery.title: Discover
discovery.text: Discover devices and review connection status. Screenshots show demonstration states of the management interface.

config.title: Configure
config.text: Adjust video and operating parameters from a browser during integration. Device configurations shown are demonstration data.

models.title: Deploy models
models.text: Browse models, deploy them and configure applications. Available functions depend on firmware and configuration.

precision: Supports INT8 / BF16. TOPS rating is for INT8.
fovNote: Theoretical reference for a 1/2.9-inch image format; not a measured module FOV.
encodingNote: Encoding capability ceiling. Current sensor capture is 1080p at 60 FPS.
operationValue: Standalone or connected to Raspberry Pi and other single-board computers.
cvbsNote: Requires the expansion board; see the three-board configuration.
customNote: Wi-Fi, IMU and custom I/O are customization options, not standard components of the listed kits.
specNote: Capture specifications, encoding capability and inference rates are separate metrics. Contact our engineers to confirm configuration, accessories and application compatibility.

dual.title: Sensor + core
dual.text: 1 × sensor board and 1 × OVIS core board for vision development and system integration.

triple.title: Sensor + CVBS + core
triple.text: 1 × sensor board, 1 × MS7024 CVBS output board and 1 × OVIS core board.

kitNote: Only confirmed board combinations are listed. Cables, additional accessories and delivered configuration are subject to the final sales list.

imaging.title: Low-light image enhancement
